preconditions.description: The dimensions of the map must be within the specified bounds.
The maximum number of different types of squares allowed in the path must be between 1 and 4.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == m for line in map_lines) and len(map_lines) == n
preconditions.description: Each line of the map must have exactly m characters, and there must be exactly n lines.
The map must contain exactly one starting square 'S' and one terminating square 'T'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout) > 0 and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdout))
postconditions.description: If a valid path exists, the output must be a sequence of lowercase letters representing the path; otherwise, it must be '-1'.
The number of different types of squares in the output path must not exceed k.
The output path must not include the starting square 'S' or the terminating square 'T'.
